description_en: During the Rāṇā era, the construction of this Śiva temple is apparent, yet its exact origin remains uncertain due to the absence of historical records and the lack of theśivaliṅgain the sanctum.Referred to simply as aśivālaya(lit. the abode of Śiva) in this documentation due to uncertainty about its name, this stone temple is located on three plinth levels north of the pathway at the Gorakhanātha complex, leading to the Viśvarūpa Mandira. Its bell-shaped roof, adorned with a metallic finial, stands out as a distinctive feature. Accessible through an entrance on all four sides embellished with a stone archway (toraṇa) featuring a central carving of Chepu, a mythical water creature, the temple's sanctum lacks aśivaliṅgaas of November 2023. A small Bhairava mask is embedded on the southern outer wall next to the entrance. However, elements such as a figure of Śiva’s animal mount Nandī, a stone trident (triśūla), and a bell, commonly found around a temple of this nature, are absent here.The absence of inscriptions at the site leaves the donor's identity and the year of the temple's construction shrouded in mystery. Despite the uncertainty surrounding its origins, the architectural characteristics suggest a construction date during the Rāṇā period (1846-1951 CE). The temple had already collapsed before the 2015 earthquakes. The Pashupati Area Development Trust undertook the temple's reconstruction in 2021 CE (VS 2078). Remarkably, theśivaliṅgainside the sanctum has yet to be restored, even after the temple's reconstruction was completed.Notably, no daily or any other worship activities occur at this temple.
description_ne: राणाकालीन यस शिवालयको पुनर्निर्माण विसं २०७८ (सन् २०१२) मा पशुपति क्षेत्र विकास कोषद्वारा गरिएको थियो ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा रहेको गोरखनाथ परिसरबाट विश्वरूप मन्दिर जाने बाटोमा यो मन्दिर रहेको छ । ढुङ्गाबाट बनेको घण्टाकार शैलीको यस शिवालयमा धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । शिवालयका चारै दिशामा ढुङ्गाका ढोकाहरू राखिएका छन् । चारै ढोकामाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण राखिएका छन् । शिवालयको गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको हुनुपर्नेमा अहिले (सन् २०२३ नोभेम्बरमा) गर्भगृह खाली नै रहेको छ । शिवालयको दक्षिणपट्टिको भित्तामा भैरवको मुखाकृति राखिएको छ । शिवालय वरिपरि नन्दी, त्रिशूल, घण्टा केही पनि स्थापना गरिएका छैनन् ।यो शिवालयको निर्माणबारे कुनै अभिलेख राखिएको पाइँदैन । त्यसैले यस शिवालयको नाम, निर्माण मिति र निर्माताबारे कुनै जानकारी पाइँदैन । शैलीको आधारमा यसलाई राणाकालीन मान्न सकिन्छ । विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) मा भूकम्पभन्दा अघि नै यो शिवालय भत्किसकेको थयो । भूकम्पछि पशुपति क्षेत्र विकास कोषले पुनर्निर्माण गरेको थियो । पुनर्निर्माण सम्पन्न भएपनि गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छैन ।यस शिवालयमा नित्यपूजा लगायतका कुनै पनि पूजा हुँदैन ।

historical_events.event_description: The Pashupati Area Development Trust undertook the temple's reconstruction in the aftermath of the 2015 earthquakes. The temple had already collapsed prior to the seismic events.
